literature.title: Searching with Consistent Prioritization for Multi-Agent Path Finding
literature.authors: Ma, H.; Harabor, D.; Stuckey, P. J.; Li, J.; Koenig, S.
literature.implementation: Independent resource-domain adaptation; not original authors' code

search.high_level: Depth-first binary priority-order search; smaller weighted-cost child first
search.conflict_selection: Earliest shared resource slot, then flight-ID pair
search.low_level: Exact minimum departure delay within the common declared candidates and grid
search.tie_breaking: Fewest incomparable-agent conflicts, then descendant conflicts, structural cost, finish, canonical structure
search.objective: Fixed 3/2/1 mission-weighted ground delay; no structural penalty in objective
search.stop: First conflict-free leaf or total wall time/expansion limit
search.timing_scope: Template construction, root planning and high-level search included; validation and disk IO excluded

analysis: Descriptive paired comparison; no new significance claims or pooling into the original three-test family. Report every failure and denominator. Same inputs/feasible domain, different search preferences; quantify individually increased ground delays relative to SPC-WSR.
